# 100.00 USD leaving the USD bank, parked against the CAD account.
#
# The payable side of Q-039, and the half the whole path shipped without: every
# other fixture here is an invoice. A bill's posting is a credit where an
# invoice's is a debit, so its settlement is the other sign — CLAUDE.md finding
# 7 — and `relink_a_parked_split` writes the negation of what the bank did,
# which is the right sign on both without knowing which it is looking at. That
# is worth a test rather than an argument.
#
# BILL-USD-001 is 100.00 USD, its payable is USD, and the bank is USD, so
# nothing converts. The money left before anybody had worked out what it was
# for, so the other side is the CAD account carrying 139.00 at 1.39 —
# an artefact of the account, as always here, and gone when it is replaced.
#
# What this fixture produces: a CAD-quoted transaction paying money out, in no
# lot, whose other side is the CAD account.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-02-25 * "Money out"

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "6d7e8f9001122334455667788a9bacbd"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.39"
		value: "-139.00"
	Assets:Due From Director 139.00 CAD
		guid: "7e8f9001122334455667788a9bacbdce"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
